tasks.label: Sync verified Node files to main
tasks.command: $backup = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'monitoreo-practicas-python-backup'; $source = (Get-Location).Path; $taskConfig = Join-Path $backup '.vscode\tasks.json'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $taskConfig) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $taskConfig }; $files = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $source -File -Recurse; foreach ($file in $files) { $relative = $file.FullName.Substring($source.Length + 1); $parts = $relative -split '[\\/]'; if ($parts -contains 'node_modules' -or $parts -contains '.git' -or $parts -contains '.vscode' -or $parts -contains '.vercel' -or $relative -eq '.env' -or $relative -eq 'cookies.txt' -or $relative -like 'data\*.json') { continue }; $destination = Join-Path $backup $relative; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path -Parent $destination) -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Destination $destination -Force }; git -C $backup add -A; git -C $backup diff --cached --check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git -C $backup status --short --branch; git -C $backup diff --cached --stat; $envLeak = git -C $backup grep -l 'elyon2026' --; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output 'SECRET_LITERAL_FOUND'; exit 1 }; Write-Output 'No configured admin password is tracked'
